text: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of Council Members to the City of Toronto Long-Term Care Committee of Management.

The Striking Committee referred the Item to the City Clerk, in consultation with the General Manager, Seniors Services and Long-Term Care, to ensure that all necessary steps have been followed prior to submitting a report on the membership of the City of Toronto Long-Term Care Committee of Management to the Striking Committee, such steps to include a new canvass of Members of Council for their interest in membership on the committee, if required.
